Read [README.md](README.md) and [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Stack: C++/MinGW, Go, TypeScript/React. Build: `npm run build` (or individual `npm run build:interceptor|native-host|extension`). Test: `npm run test`.

Privacy/local-first: keep data local/offline; external calls only when necessary (Gmail API); avoid paid services. TypeScript strict mode. Colocate related code; minimize bloat. Use React Bootstrap/Radix UI; No Tailwind. Support translations via message catalogs/i18n; technical documentation remains in English.

`src/interceptor/`: Simple MAPI only; zero external dependencies (no nlohmann/json - hand-rolled JSON); non-blocking/thread-safe; writes `%TEMP%\go-mapi\`. Always test with debug build: `npm run build:interceptor:debug`. Test multiple apps; check leaks/thread safety.

`src/native-host/`: Chrome Native Messaging, filesystem watching, length-prefixed JSON; run `gofmt` before committing; test messaging; handle deleted files/permission errors.

`src/extension/`: React 18, React Bootstrap, Vite, TypeScript; Chrome Identity API OAuth; keep service worker minimal; test Chrome and Edge.

Schema: [docs/json-schema.json](docs/json-schema.json). Comment the "why", not the "what"; document non-obvious constraints; keep comments concise. Conventional Commits: `feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `test:`, `refactor:`, `chore:`.

Workflow: understand component; read sources; run tests; identify related files; follow patterns; keep changes minimal; add tests; update docs. Run full build: `npm run build`; run tests: `npm run test`; test manually for user-facing changes; write clear commits.

Changes: update schema, C++ `json_writer.cpp`, TypeScript types, Go structs. Settings: Chrome storage API, UI, service worker, `chrome.storage.sync`. Release: `npm run build`; `npm run register:mapi`; load extension; inspect `%TEMP%\go-mapi\` and DevTools.
